name: clearrun
description: ClearRun open-core — honesty verdict contract, SDK, CLI, vendors, security, scoring UI mapping.

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @clearrun/core-types && npm run build -w @clearrun/sdk && npm run build -w @clearrun/scoring && npm run build -w @clearrun/security && npm run build -w @clearrun/vendors && npm run build -w @clearrun/cli
scripts.test:sdk: npm run build -w @clearrun/core-types && npm run test -w @clearrun/sdk
scripts.test: npm run test:sdk && npm run validate:schema
